name: usage-chart
title: Usage Chart
description: A chart of numbers over time for up to five series, as stacked bars, lines or stacked areas, in the chart colors, with a title, a legend, hover details with a total, and the same numbers as a table for screen readers. Drawn with Recharts. Takes a title, the series, the data points and an optional unit.

meta.use_when: People need to see how credits, generations or another number changed over days or weeks, split by tool or plan
